messages: Holodeck 2 is unstable. Enter at your own risk.
Radiation leak in the port nacelle. Avoid area.
Replicator 3 produces only decaf. Engineering notified.
Unidentified life-form in cargo bay. Possibly a potato.
Shields at 40%. Captain's optimism remains at 100%.
Artificial gravity testing at 1400. Secure your lunch.
Red alert cancelled. Someone leaned on the console.
Please stop asking the computer for relationship advice.
